{{TierBar}}


'''Nexus Parasites''' are a unique Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier placement is relatively arbitrary, as they evolve while staying in the same Tier. This Tier contains 3 unique Mobs, each with 4 Stages, with 12 Mobs in total. 

Parasites part of the Nexus Tier, depending on the stage, must be approached with caution because of their game changing capabilities, but must be killed as soon as possible to prevent further catastrophe.

== Spawning ==
===Beckons===
*Stage I Beckons spawn purely from the [[Reinforcement System]]:
**Randomly upon the death of Parasites larger than 1 block.
**Randomly on [[Residue]] (Chance increases with [[Evolution Phases]]).
**On [[Infested Blocks]], created by other Beckons.
*Stage IV Beckons can spawn all lower tiers of Beckons.

===Dispatchers===
*Stage I Dispatchers spawn from a [[Dispatcher Nidus]] block.
**If [[Ubiquitous Development]] is level 3 or higher, can spawn naturally without the use of Nidi.

===Rooters===
*Stage I Rooters are summoned by Stage II and III Beckons or Dispatchers with a 2% chance roughly every second.
**If [[Ubiquitous Development]] is level 3 or higher, can spawn naturally without other Nexuses.

Subsequent Nexuses following Stage I evolve from their predecessors after enough time has passed. This time-based evolution can fail at lower [[Evolution Phases]]. 

If a [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, higher tier Nexuses will turn into their previous Stage after death.

==''Shared Aspects and Capabilities''==
=== ''Capabilities'' ===
*All Nexus parasites, to some degree, make use of other (summoned) parasites to aid them. 
**Beckons utilize [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]], other parasite summons, and, in the case of Stage IV Beckons, themselves.
**Dispatchers utilize [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]] and nearby parasites.
**Rooters utilize [[Rootmass Cyst|Rootmass Cysts]].
*Nexus parasites do not despawn naturally.
*Nexus parasites are able to create structures that aid greatly in parasite takeover.
**Stage IV Beckons are able to create [[Parasite Biome|Nodes]] starting from Ubiquitous Development level 4.
**Stage IV Dispatchers are able to create [[Colony|Colonies]] starting from Ubiquitous Development level 4.
**All Nexuses, when evolving from Stage I to Stage II, have a chance to create [[Nests]].
***Rooter Nests increase Beckon infestation speed.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Like all Parasites, Nexus parasites present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).
* Stage IV Nexuses present a weakspot on their top segment. Hitting this weakspot will deal 3x damage and apply [[Bleeding]] to the Nexus.
* [[Biome Purifier|Biome Purifiers]] will apply the Glowing effect to Nexus parasites within a 32-block radius when used. 
* Right-clicking Dispatcher Tentacles or Seizers will apply the Glowing effect to their parent Dispatcher.

== ''[[Survival Guides]]'' ==
Destroy the Nexus Parasite as soon as possible, you may go directly in if the target is weak, but if not:

If the Nexus Parasite is on the surface: 

Nexus parasites have a very high distance of view, towering over them wont work. But an invisility potion helps with that. Climb over the target and pour lava on it, if lacking lava, dont shoot if you are not able to fight the things they spawn, wait till you get one (Nether suggested)

If the Nexus Parasite is in the caves:

Parasites thrive in caves, but it also means that they will break lots of blocks in the area with tunnels. Try to bomb or shoot the exposed target from a distance or again, pour lava

== ''[[Lore]]'' ==
(Note: This is not confirmed, it is only made wither scraps of info, which means it can be entirely wrong)

It is theorised that there is a huge ancient parasite nest (aptly named The Source) underground, and Beckons are its tentacles reaching from deep underground, while Dispatchers serve as temporary area control either before the area is infected or just to make the infected area more dangerous.
